about: Fictional descriptions for the optional service helper (POST /finder/suggest). 'first' is the ideal first suggestion, or null when nothing should be suggested; 'urgent' means the fixed emergency guidance must be shown instead. 'keywords_miss' marks a case the keyword fallback is known to get wrong, so only the AI can catch it; the page's emergency contacts stay visible either way. The catalogue copies the demo seed (scripts/seed.ts). Never put real student text here.

catalogue.name: Academic Stress Counselling
catalogue.description: Talk through exam pressure, deadlines, study worries or feeling behind.

catalogue.name: General Counselling
catalogue.description: Anything weighing on you: low mood, anxiety, relationships, family or grief. No problem is too small.

catalogue.name: Urgent Drop-in
catalogue.description: A shorter, sooner conversation when something can't wait. In an emergency, call the emergency numbers instead.
